title: infinity-1-category
description: An ∞-category in which every k-morphism for k > 1 is invertible — the higher morphisms witness homotopies, not directed transformations. The setting of most ∞-categories arising in practice: spaces, spectra, derived and sheaf categories. An ∞-category refined by higher invertibility.

higher-morphisms-invertible.description: every k-morphism for k > 1 is invertible
